name: novel-to-manga-anime-generator
description: AI novel-to-manga, comic and anime video generator: REF sheets, page/shot planning, Seedream & Seedance prompts, optional automatic generation via BytePlus ModelArk API. 中文/English/日本語.

interface.shortDescription: Turn novel text into manga, comics or anime videos — 小說轉漫畫／動畫・小説を漫画・アニメに
interface.longDescription: Paste a chapter and choose comic or video. The plugin builds character/location/prop reference sheets, adapts the story into pages and panels or minutes and shots, and writes ready-to-use Seedream (image) and Seedance (video) prompts. Optional scripts let an agent generate everything automatically through the BytePlus ModelArk API. Works in Chinese, English and Japanese.
defaultPrompt: Turn this chapter into a manga: [paste text]
把這段小說做成 3 分鐘動畫：[貼上內容]
この小説を漫画にしてください：[本文を貼り付け]
